description: Performance budget for the Pegasus 43 phone product page, verified against real Chrome traces under throttled conditions. See TRACE-FINDINGS.md for the full measurement log.

layoutShift.target: [data-testid="size-grid"] element (currently addressed by .grid.grid-cols-5 selector — no data-testid attribute exists in the markup yet)

firstContentfulPaint.measuredMs: 750-780 (next dev server; re-measure against a production build before trusting this number)

productImage.status: pass (as served by next/image optimizer; the committed source file itself is larger and should be compressed before adding more images)

notes: All measurements come from a Next.js dev server (`npm run dev`), not a production build. Dev-mode bundles more JS and compiles on first request, so load-event and FCP numbers here are pessimistic relative to production.
Zero layout-shift events were recorded by both the Layout Instability PerformanceObserver API and the raw Chrome trace file in every run (6 total runs across 3 experiments, 2 runs each).
